assumptions: Nominal freshwater density 1000 kg/m³ unless overridden.
Frame mass and CG represent the combined hull/frame assembly.
Blank mass rows are excluded, not estimated.
Only the supplied hull solid contributes buoyancy; tubes and appendages are excluded.
Calm water, no speed, waves, thrust or mooring forces.
Upper CAD closure is treated as sealed; physical downflooding is not modeled.
Component markers show CG positions, not component sizes.
